def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # separator lines divide into equal-sized cells; their color is retained
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_tiles = [(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    col_tiles = [(col_bounds[i]+1, col_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    candidates=[]
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(row_tiles):
      for ci,(x,y) in enumerate(col_tiles):
        cells=[grid[r][c] for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)]
        candidates.append((sum(v != 0 for v in cells),ri,ci))
    _, sri,sci=max(candidates)
    a,b=row_tiles[sri]; x,y=col_tiles[sci]
    tile=[grid[r][x:y] for r in range(a,b)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,(ra,rb) in enumerate(row_tiles):
      for ci,(ca,cb) in enumerate(col_tiles):
        if (ri,ci)==(sri,sci): continue
        for r in range(ra,rb):
          for c in range(ca,cb):
            out[r][c]=tile[(r-ra)%len(tile)][(c-ca)%len(tile[0])]
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    """Tile the middle 4x4 motif into left and right blank 4x4 areas."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Motif occupies rows/cols between the horizontal/vertical separators.
    sep_r = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    sep_c = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    # For this layout, separator at col 4 and row 5; motif is columns 5..8.
    # Copy those cells across the two four-column side blocks.
    for r in range(h):
        if r == sep_r:
            continue
        for c in range(w):
            if c < sep_c or c > sep_c:
                # Source pattern is the block immediately right of vertical bar,
                # except the rightmost separator at the next block boundary.
                source_c = 5 + (c % 4)
                if source_c < w:
                    out[r][c] = grid[r][source_c]
    return out
PY
